    "content": "When a function contains multiple code branches that each handle the same external input (e.g., a qualified composite-key path vs. a bare-key fallback path), every branch must apply input validation before any I/O operation — not just the primary or \"obvious\" branch. The fix is to place the validation call as the first statement in each branch, before any readdir, stat, or join call.
